title: Doug Dies in Every Video (Real Science, Terrible Drawings)
description:
Doug dies in every video. The science is real. Subscribe to see how he dies next: https://www.youtube.com/@DoomedDoug?sub_confirmation=1
A new video every day for our first four weeks, then every Friday.

Watch the deaths in this trailer:
What Dying From Every Parasite Would Feel Like (brain-eating amoeba, jewel wasp): https://youtu.be/xra1KWBfC7A
How Doug Would Die in Every Layer of the Ocean (black swallower): https://youtu.be/9eiX84Ik1Sc
What Dying in Every Deadly Place on Earth Would Be Like (quicksand, Nyiragongo): https://youtu.be/_fudGWs5yJU
What Dying Every Time Earth Froze Would Be Like (Snowball Earth): https://youtu.be/SAcFbGY0KBg

Educational entertainment. All deaths are cartoon depictions; the science is real and sourced (the 97% amoeba fatality rate is CDC data: 4 survivors of 167 US cases, 1962-2024).

The narration is an AI text-to-speech voice. Scripts are researched and written with AI assistance and fact-checked. All drawings are original.
